Mahindra Teases Upcoming Scorpio N Pickup Truck

Mahindra has released a teaser for an upcoming pickup truck based on the Scorpio N. The vehicle was spotted during testing, and details suggest it will feature modern amenities. The company is expected to launch the pickup soon, potentially alongside an updated electric SUV around August 15th. The new pickup is anticipated to include features such as a panoramic sunroof.
